claim_assertions.claim_1: The disclosed FY2026 acquisition revenue contribution equals its disclosed Q4 contribution.
claim_assertions.claim_2: The Q3 service-offering rename changed revenue allocation.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Subtracting the disclosed Informatica contribution from FY2026 total revenue gives an arithmetic current-period revenue amount of USD 41,126 million.

definitions.income_model: Three, nine and twelve months in each fiscal year. months=3 is Q4. Signed tax adds to pretax income. For each matching period, reconstructed pretax income is reconstructed operating income plus strategic gains and other income. Reconstructed net income is reconstructed pretax income plus signed tax. residual_usd_million is reconstructed net income less independently reported net income.
definitions.operating_adjustment_bridge: Ordinary SBC excludes SBC already in restructuring. Report the latter for audit but add each exclusion once. Residual compares with the matching reported adjusted operating basis. Adjusted operating income is reconstructed GAAP operating income plus amortization, ordinary SBC and restructuring/acquisition exclusions, with restructuring SBC excluded from ordinary SBC so it is included once. adjusted_margin_pct is 100 times reconstructed adjusted operating income divided by reconstructed matching-period revenue (subscription plus professional services). residual_usd_million is reconstructed adjusted operating income less independently reported adjusted operating income.
definitions.acquisition_scope: Q4 and annual current and prior revenue, disclosed acquisition contribution, arithmetic current less acquisition, both growth rates and current subscription less disclosed acquired subscription. This is not labeled exact organic growth.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
